config:
# RQ4 failure and recovery (spec 5.1 and 6.1). harness/recovery.py expands this into adapter runs.
# Decision 12: the client never retries the same server, so retry_same is disabled for every arm.

# Which policies each arm runs after a rejected answer. A baseline never rejects, so it only aborts
# (its faults end silent_wrong, which is the threat verification removes).
policies:
  S0-go: [abort]
  S0-cpp: [abort]
  M0: [abort]
  S1: [abort, switch_replica, re_preprocess]
  S2: [abort, switch_replica, re_preprocess]
  S3: [abort, switch_replica]
  S4: [abort, switch_replica]
  M1: [abort, switch_replica]

# Faults per arm, as the adapter contract defines them (src/adapters/README.md, "Faults").
# Online faults run with each policy. Offline faults are detection-only: no recovery is defined after
# a rejected preprocessing phase, so they run with abort.
faults:
  online: [flip_answer_bit, wrong_record, stale_record, drop_server]
  offline:
    flip_hint_bit: [S0-go, S0-cpp, S1, S2]
    bad_proof: [S1, S2]

# Focus cells (spec 5.1): DB in {128 MiB, 1 GiB} x record in {32 B, 1 KiB}, every arm where it runs.
# S3 and S4 retrieve one bit (record 0). S4 runs only up to 1 MiB (decision 10, spec v1.6), so it has
# no focus cell. S1, S2 and S3 need more than 14 GiB at 1 GiB (notebooks/08_memory_ceiling.ipynb,
# cell 2), so they have no 1 GiB cell on this Mac. M1 also needs more at 1 GiB with 32 B records but
# not with 8 KiB ones; its 1 GiB x 32 B Runs stay and end oom at the cap.
# The spec lets the humans shrink this to 1 GiB x 1 KiB if time is short.
focus_cells:
  db_bytes: [134217728, 1073741824]
  record_bytes: [32, 1024]
one_bit_arms: [S3, S4]
max_db_bytes:
  S1: 134217728
  S2: 134217728
  S3: 134217728
  S4: 1048576

# Repetitions (spec 5.1): 100 trials per (arm, fault, policy), plus one warm-up.
trials: 100
warmup: 1

# Cheating-rate sweep (spec 5.1): each query's server cheats with probability f, 1000 queries per f.
# Under switch_replica the replicas cheat at the same rate (--replicas-cheat), so the measured cost can
# be checked against the cost computed from the component costs (spec 6.1). A cheating server returns
# another record's honest answer (wrong_record), a deliberate cheat rather than a transmission error.
cheating:
  fault: wrong_record
  rates: [0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0]
  queries: 1000

seed: 1234
# Per adapter process. Notebook 07's feasibility run gives the costs this has to cover.
timeout_s: 14400
# The spec calls a cell oom above 16 GiB, the Mac's RAM; macOS and the editor need about 2 GiB of it.
# M1 at 128 MiB x 32 B needs 11.7 GiB (notebook 08, cell 2).
memory_cap_gib: 14
